steps.en: Notices of FIN holders are picked for a check
steps.id: Notice pemegang FIN dipilih untuk dicek
steps.why_en: The selection job is switched off in the live environment.
steps.why_id: Job pemilihan dimatikan di lingkungan live.

steps.en: Foreign passport holders are picked for a check
steps.id: Pemegang foreign passport dipilih untuk dicek
steps.why_en: Passport holders are never picked for a check.
steps.why_id: Pemegang passport tidak pernah dipilih untuk dicek.

steps.en: FIN numbers are sent to the immigration and manpower data sources
steps.id: Nomor FIN dikirim ke sumber data imigrasi dan tenaga kerja
steps.why_en: Built, but the job is off live and the live data views are unverified.
steps.why_id: Sudah dibuat, tetapi job mati di live dan view data live belum diverifikasi.

steps.en: The latest home address of the foreigner is saved on the notice
steps.id: Alamat rumah terbaru warga asing disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: Only work-pass and pass holders get an address; the job is off live.
steps.why_id: Hanya pemegang work pass dan pass yang dapat alamat; job mati di live.

steps.en: The foreigner pass status is saved against the notice
steps.id: Status pass warga asing disimpan pada notice

steps.en: The foreigner name and birth date are refreshed on the notice
steps.id: Nama dan tanggal lahir warga asing diperbarui di notice
steps.why_en: The update can also overwrite other people on the same notice.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan bisa ikut menimpa data orang lain pada notice yang sama.
